title: Check yourself: Per-item passes, adaptive guards and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: In an adaptive investigation the step chooser keeps proposing "list the test files", which was already done, and the loop hits its step limit each time. What is the best change?

options.text: Double the step limit and let the planner move on by itself
options.says: Ruled out because the limit is a backstop and the cause is the lack of progress: "A loop that runs into it needs a progress check".

options.text: Halt with a stuck status once a task repeats, and name the repeated one
options.says: A repeated subtask is a lack of progress, and a status says so.

options.text: Remove the planner's history and judge every request on its own
options.says: Ruled out because the history is what lets the planner see what it has done: "The planner is given the goal and the steps done so far".

options.text: Let the worker skip the repeated subtask silently and carry on with the next
options.says: Ruled out because a silent skip leaves no status behind: "so that a reader of the result can tell them apart".

questions.stem: A large review runs one pass per module and then a final pass across modules. What should the final pass receive?

options.text: The complete text of each module, laid side by side for comparison
options.says: Ruled out because the text would bring the overload back: "the one overloaded request that the split removed".

options.text: The findings of the earlier passes, with no account of the modules
options.says: Ruled out because findings alone say nothing about what the files offer: "what the file offers (the functions and types others use, with their parameters)".

options.text: The changed lines of every module, copied out of each pass
options.says: Ruled out because copied text brings the problem back: "A summary that copies the file brings the problem back."

options.text: A short summary per unit of what it offers and what it expects
options.says: Summaries are the interface between the passes.
